hazard_consequence_node.label: HazardConsequence
hazard_consequence_node.name: Confined explosion
hazard_consequence_node.evidence: The report states that on January 7, 2010, the student was injured "after the chemical he was working with detonated." In the incident description, "he transferred about half of the synthesized NHP into a mortar, added hexane... [and] the compound detonated." The analysis repeatedly focuses on the explosive hazards of the energetic material, the scale-up to about 10 grams, and the lack of formal hazard evaluation for that explosive risk.
hazard_consequence_node.explanation: The central accident mechanism analyzed is the detonation/explosion of an energetic solid during handling in a mortar. Among the available labels, this is best represented as a confined explosion because the incident is fundamentally an explosive event localized in handling equipment, not a vapor cloud, BLEVE, dust cloud, fire, or toxic/asphyxiation event.

entity_nodes.label: Material
entity_nodes.name: nickel hydrazine perchlorate (NHP) derivative
entity_nodes.evidence: "began synthesizing a nickel hydrazine perchlorate (NHP) derivative"
entity_nodes.explanation: This was the energetic compound being synthesized, scaled up, and handled when the detonation occurred.

entity_nodes.label: Location
entity_nodes.name: mortar
entity_nodes.evidence: "transferred about half of the synthesized NHP into a mortar"
entity_nodes.explanation: The material was being handled in a mortar immediately before the explosion.

condition_nodes.label: Phase
condition_nodes.name: Solid
condition_nodes.explanation: The energetic material was present as a solid product, although it had been wetted with hexane.

condition_nodes.label: Combustibility
condition_nodes.name: Combustible
condition_nodes.evidence: "the potential explosive hazards associated with the quantity of NHP synthesized"
condition_nodes.explanation: The material exhibited energetic behavior and detonated, indicating combustible/explosive reactivity.

condition_nodes.label: Confinement
condition_nodes.name: Low confinement
condition_nodes.explanation: The material was in an open mortar rather than a closed vessel, indicating limited confinement.

event_nodes.label: InitiatingEvent
event_nodes.name: Scale-up of NHP synthesis to approximately 10 grams
event_nodes.evidence: "they decided to scale-up the synthesis of NHP to make approximately 10 grams"
event_nodes.explanation: The accident sequence began when the energetic material was intentionally scaled up from small laboratory quantities to a much larger batch.

event_nodes.label: IgnitionSource
event_nodes.name: Unknown ignition source
event_nodes.evidence: "did not replace his goggles while he stirred the NHP “one more time.” At this point, the compound detonated."
event_nodes.explanation: A detonation occurred during manual stirring, but the incident description does not identify the exact ignition or initiation source.
